about: Marine Lines is where Mumbai is at its most beautiful. Home to the iconic Marine Drive - the Queen's Necklace - it is one of the world's great urban seafronts. The area combines the prestige of Nariman Point, the heritage of Churchgate, the greenery of Azad Maidan and the quiet elegance of its residential lanes into one of India's most coveted addresses. Whether you need a dentist near Churchgate, a salon on Marine Drive, or a reliable plumber in the Cooperage belt - Mumbai96 has verified listings with real reviews, direct numbers and everything a Mumbaikar needs to find the right service fast.

character_vibe_description: Character & Vibe An honest snapshot - the energy, the people, the pace. The kind of thing no other directory tells you. Marine Lines operates at two speeds. By day, it is all business - Churchgate's commuter rush, Nariman Point's corporate corridors, lawyers in black coats striding to the High Court. By evening, it transforms into something else entirely: the promenade fills with walkers, joggers, couples and families, all drawn to the same thing - the sea, the breeze and the lights. It is one of the few places in Mumbai where you can walk from your front door to the Arabian Sea in under two minutes. The residents know this and guard it fiercely. Old Parsi families, senior advocates, corporate executives and a growing number of young professionals who have discovered that no suburb can replicate what Marine Lines offers - the city at its most civilised.

resident_profile_description: Resident Profile A cross-section of Mumbai's most distinguished residents - here's who you'll find calling Marine Lines home. Marine Lines is home to some of Mumbai's most established families. Old Parsi households have occupied the same Art Deco flats for three generations. Corporate executives at Nariman Point firms choose Marine Drive for the commute that takes minutes and the view that is priceless. And increasingly, young professionals are discovering that a small flat on Marine Lines is worth more than a large one anywhere else.

faq.question: What is Marine Lines known for?
faq.answer: Marine Lines is known for Marine Drive - the iconic Queen's Necklace promenade along the Arabian Sea - as well as its proximity to Churchgate, Nariman Point, Azad Maidan and the Cooperage football ground. It is one of South Mumbai's most prestigious and well-connected residential addresses.

faq.question: What is the pin code of Marine Lines?
faq.answer: Marine Lines has the pin code 400020. The adjacent Churchgate area uses 400020 as well, while Nariman Point uses 400021.

faq.question: What are the sub-areas within Marine Lines?
faq.answer: The main micro-localities within Marine Lines are Marine Drive, Churchgate, Nariman Point, Azad Maidan, Cooperage, Dinshaw Wacha Road, Waudby Road, and the Eros Cinema belt.

faq.question: What is the property price in Marine Lines?
faq.answer: Property prices in Marine Lines range from ₹2 Cr for a 1BHK in the non-sea-facing lanes to ₹4–8 Cr for a 2BHK sea-facing apartment on Marine Drive, and ₹8 Cr+ for premium sea-facing floors. Rental rates range from ₹45,000 to ₹2.5 lakh per month depending on the sub-area, floor and sea view (as of May 2026).

faq.question: How to commute from Marine Lines?
faq.answer: Marine Lines is served by Western Railway's Marine Lines Station (3 min to Churchgate), BEST bus routes 1, 2, 3, 106, 132, and direct access to Marine Drive and the Eastern Freeway. Taxis and autos are abundantly available. The area is also walkable to Churchgate and Nariman Point.

faq.question: Which hospitals are in Marine Lines?
faq.answer: Major hospitals in and near Marine Lines include Bombay Hospital, Saifee Hospital, Wockhardt Hospital, St. George's Hospital, and Cama & Albless Hospital.

faq.question: Which schools are in Marine Lines?
faq.answer: Notable schools in Marine Lines include Cathedral & John Connon School, Elphinstone College, New Era High School, Queen Mary School, and St. Xavier's College (nearby Churchgate).
